assets.name: Bitcoin

events.title: 特斯拉披露购入比特币

events.title: 萨尔瓦多《比特币法》生效
events.description: 该法律使比特币在萨尔瓦多获得法定货币地位。

events.title: Terra / LUNA 市场冲击

events.title: FTX 申请破产保护
events.description: FTX 集团在美国启动 Chapter 11 破产程序。

events.title: 美国现货比特币 ETP 获批
events.description: 美国 SEC 批准多只现货比特币交易所交易产品。

events.title: 第四次区块奖励减半
events.description: 区块补贴由 6.25 BTC 降至 3.125 BTC。

googleTrends.definition: 全球 Google 网页搜索中的相对关注度。数值是抽样并标准化后的指数，不代表绝对搜索次数。

source.calibration: two overlapping multi-year weekly windows; each window anchored to the full-range monthly series by the median positive-month scale ratio; shared weeks averaged; final series normalized to a peak of 100
source.samplingNote: Google Trends uses a sample of aggregated, anonymized searches; repeated downloads can differ slightly.
source.aggregation: calendar-period arithmetic mean of calibrated weekly index
source.dailyUnavailableReason: Across a 2018-2026 study window, Google Trends Explore does not return one native daily series. Daily display is disabled instead of interpolating values.

events.title: 美国现货 Ether ETP 开始交易
